bounded_source_fidelity_gate_outcome_rev: passed, subject to independently verified source/provenance identity
outage_performance_acceptance: qualified/deferred; 60-second recovery regresses in this return and longer-freshness recovery remains limited
source_semantic_acceptance_recommendatio: Accept bounded NWK semantic corrections with the measured 60-second delivery regression explicitly retained, subject to the separate provenance/source gate. Do not label the tranche an outage delivery improvement.
limitations: Three matched seeds are case identifiers and are not identical random draws after changed event ordering; this is not a statistically established population-level performance change.
Recovery uses explicit discovery at 576/581/586 seconds after restoration at 540 seconds. It does not measure autonomous convergence.
Blackout is an administrative receive-completion exclusion for relay 2 during [405,540); radios and timers continue. The underlying PHY runs, but this is not a physical fade experiment.
ns-3 applies the receive gate after MAC bookkeeping while MATLAB gates before MAC bookkeeping, and their security representations differ.
ns-3 reports exact local no-ACK completions and empty observed queues; exact global dropped/pending categories remain unknown. Do not substitute local HOP failures for global application loss.
The 900-second snapshot does not prove that stop-boundary controls subsequently drain; current MATLAB MAC feedback queue depth is not exported.
Conditional latency statistics only include applications delivered in both runs. Excluding two newly dropped slow applications makes raw delivered-only averages misleading.
recommended_next_target: Address the route-selection-to-DATA-retry boundary as an explicit behavioral decision: log packet custody owner, selected route/next-hop validity, expiry deadline and failure callback; validate healthy-link false expiry, blackout retry-before-expiry, post-restore rediscovery and bounded custody without duplicates. Preserve source-compatible DATA behavior as the baseline; any recovery retention or outage-trigger policy must be identified as a deliberate extension and validated separately, rather than achieved by tuning freshness to this seed set.
